{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for unusual revenue values (the 6 QA orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Check for invalid revenue strings
# We'll check if any revenue string has commas or is not a valid float
import re
invalid_revenue = df[~df['revenue'].str.match(r'^\d+,?\d*\.\d{2}$')]
print("Invalid revenue format count:", len(invalid_revenue))

# Display first few rows of revenue to inspect
print("First few revenue values:", df['revenue'].head().tolist())"}
